title: Full-Frame Logo Photography
slide_intent: Let the image carry the message while protecting identification because a logo-only composition still needs a clear visual anchor.
strategic_value: Close-up ingredient textures can express Burger King’s food focus with minimal verbal content.
demonstration: Four photographs of lettuce, onion, sesame bun and tomato each carry a contrasting centered Burger King logo.
practical_value: Choose an image region and logo color that preserve clearspace and sufficient contrast.

content_islands.name: Logo-only condition
content_islands.spec: Place the short explanation in the left column.

content_islands.name: Ingredient compositions
content_islands.spec: Arrange a tall lettuce example beside smaller onion and bun examples above a wide tomato example, each with the logo overlaid.

ingredient.name: Logo-only photographic layout
ingredient.role: Identify the brand within an ingredient image.
ingredient.application: Overlay only the logo when sufficient clearspace and contrast can be retained.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. No new numeric clearspace or contrast threshold is specified here.

reference_purposes.Expression: The ingredient textures and contrasting marks demonstrate a minimal food-led treatment.
reference_purposes.Application: The examples apply only the logo over full-frame photography.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The copy requires sufficient logo clearspace and enough contrast against the photograph.
